name: DEAD
desc:
Run. Hide. Fear the Dead.

DEAD is an Infection Tag-inspired game where one player is chosen to be a zombie and hunt down all the other players before time runs out. If you are tagged, you join the horde in the hunt for the living.

Live. Die. Join the Dead.

[HALLOWEEN!] Infect survivors and survive the night to get candies! Candies can be used to purchase the new halloween-exclusive items!

use /modcall to request assistance. please don't abuse it, we are not afraid to temp ban modcall abusers.
use /votekick [username] to votekick annoying players. the server will hold a vote. 50% or more, and the player is kicked.

purchase a VIP server to try unfinished maps and bonus content! use the commands /givemethemaps and /letstestsomemaps to try them out with your friends!

version 2.2
changelogs available on the community server

scripts.features:
Features:
Bypasses the Weapon Restrictions: 
It forces the game to give you restricted or unreleased developer weapons (M4A1, M590A1) and explosives (Frag, NukeFrag) that are sitting in the game's storage files (ReplicatedStorage), bypassing normal progression or item locks.

Deals Damage to Other Players: 
Because the items replicate globally, any bullets fired from the guns or explosions triggered by the grenades will successfully hit, damage, and eliminate other players on the server.

Enables Hidden Weapon UIs:
It automatically turns on the weapon's built-in ShowHUD value. This forces the crosshairs, custom ammo counters, or weapon menus to display on your screen perfectly, even if they were disabled by default.

Forces Infinite "Survivals" Stat: 
Clicking the VIP button immediately rewrites your local leaderboard stat, maxing out your "Survivals" counter to 9999.
(If correct ?)

Removes Map Barriers: 
The script deletes the physical VIPDoor and UltraDoor parts from the Lobby. This completely opens up those restricted rooms so you can walk straight through them without buying a gamepass or meeting the level requirements.
